title: Laya Flappy Bird
shortDescription: A Flappy Bird game where a Laya model decides when the bird flaps.
description: A Pygame Flappy Bird where the player is a model. Every frame the game describes the bird's height and speed and the next pipe's opening as text, sends it to a Laya Router, and the model answers flap or wait with a confidence score shown on screen. A few safety rules can override the model to keep the bird near the gap.

technicalDetails.problem: Can a language model act as the decision maker in a real-time game?
technicalDetails.approach: Turn the game state into a short text prompt each frame, read the model's flap or wait choice and its confidence, and apply simple override rules near the edges.
